name: Monument Valley
summary: The red-sandstone buttes that ARE the American West — the backdrop of a hundred Westerns, on Navajo land.

lodging.name: The View Hotel
lodging.blurb: Every room faces the Mittens — a Navajo-owned lodge.

item.blurb: The 17-mile scenic loop among the Mittens and Merrick Butte (a Navajo-guided tour reaches the restricted areas); catch 'Forrest Gump Point' on US-163.

days.label: Day 372 — North into Utah
days.summary: Up the San Juan into red-rock country.

commute.scenicNote: North on US-163 past Mexican Hat, then up through Bluff and Blanding with the Abajos on your left — the Valley of the Gods and the Moki Dugway are both a short detour off it and both worth taking.

stopsAlongWay.title: Valley of the Gods
stopsAlongWay.blurb: A seventeen-mile dirt loop through buttes that look like Monument Valley with nobody in it, and no fee, and no gate.
